locations.note: The imperial capital of Sengoku-era Kansai, one of the open world's major cities.
Part of the Kansai map where shinobi Naoe and samurai Yasuke pursue their enemies.
The ninja story includes the historical Iga region.
The campaign crosses the historical province around Lake Biwa.
The western campaign includes the historical Harima region.
Naoe travels to Yamato on the trail of the Assassin Tsuyu and the Imperial Regalia the Assassins once guarded there.
The mountains of Tamba, with Fukuchiyama castle, on the Kansai map.
In Wakasa Naoe and Yasuke find a strange door, and the Templars hunt the Isu vault hidden on the coast.
Naoe infiltrates the Honnō-ji temple and confronts Nobunaga.
Sakai is where the protagonists gather allies.
Kobe is one of the cities of the Kansai map, the port below Rokko.

Claws of Awaji: Naoe follows a lead on Tsuyu to the island, held by the Sanzoku Ippa outlaws, and finds her mother there.
